_comment: Anthropic LIST prices, USD per MTok. THE single source of truth: both routing-report.py and the nightly langfuse-cost-snapshot.py read this file, and neither carries its own table. cache_read = 0.1x input; 5-min cache_write = 1.25x input (a 1-HOUR cache write is 2.0x, but usage_details cannot distinguish cache TTL, so 1h traffic is understated here). Personal traffic runs on the subscription, so these are a notional value / quota proxy, not cash — only work-* sessions are real per-token spend. Set valid_until on any promotional rate: the snapshot warns once the run date passes it, instead of silently pricing at a dead rate.

claude-sonnet-5._note: $2/$10 is the standing rate — confirmed by Anthropic email to Alex 2026-08-14 that it is not changing. The published 2026-08-31 intro expiry no longer applies, so no valid_until: it would have fired a spurious expiry warning on 2026-09-01 for a live rate.
